SO many reasons. I'm not even a father...not even in a relationship...but every time I see a baby, I get excited. There is so much JOY and WONDER in such a little life. I want to know the life of being a dad and guiding new life to know the joys of God Almighty. I am fascinated by God's design - to start us off as little babies and I long to know my future children for all that they are. And as a man, as a guy who longs to be a father, to be pro-life is a no-brainer. That's the DEFAULT position. If I'm to protect the life of my children when they're born, why would I do any less while they're still in their mother's womb where they're MEANT TO BE during their initial stages of development? I'm pro-life because children are a treasure. I get SO MUCH EXCITEMENT just to hear baby babble from other children whom I'll never hear of or see after that moment. And every child conceived DESERVES the right to have a chance at life...to babble away joyfully while there's joy yet to have.
